title: Dual-ligand europium-based metal–organic frameworks and hydrogels for sensitive ratiometric fluorescent detection of tetracyclines in food
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1322-1334
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08234J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruipeng Guo, Sujiao He, Bing Zhu, Zhiwen Xi, Jiaxin Wang, Mingsha Jie
A dual-ligand europium-based metal–organic framework (NH2-BDC-Eu-DPA) fluorescent probe and its corresponding hydrogel were developed for ratiometric fluorescent detection and visual analysis of TCs in animal-derived foods.
